review_locator: PMCID:PMC4480235, myeloid C-type lectin signaling review
primary_title: Syk-dependent cytokine production downstream of Dectin-1
decision_basis: Beta-glucan/zymosan stimulation phosphorylates the Dectin-1 hemITAM and supports Syk recruitment with Syk-dependent cytokine outputs
limitations_preserved: Promote clustered Dectin-1 hemITAM pY15-to-SYK recruitment; preserve beta-glucan/zymosan myeloid context and no full-length structural, SCI or terminal-TF claim.

primary_title: The role of SHIP1 in Dectin-1 signaling
decision_basis: Dectin-1 phosphopeptide pull-down and Y15F assays support SHIP1 recruitment, with phagosome colocalization and SHIP1-dependent ROS modulation
limitations_preserved: Promote Dectin-1 pY15-associated SHIP1 negative/competitive recruitment; preserve Y3/Y15 hemITAM context and Candida/zymosan myeloid models, with no universal Dectin-1 output or SCI inference.

primary_title: Protein kinase C-delta regulates Dectin-1-mediated phagocytosis and reactive oxygen species production
decision_basis: A phosphorylated Dectin-1 tail peptide binds PKC-delta and PKC-delta inhibition/knockdown alters zymosan-induced ROS and phagocytosis
limitations_preserved: Promote Dectin-1 hemITAM-associated PKC-delta recruitment/function; preserve peptide-level binding and downstream perturbation limits, without exclusivity, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: CD36 assembles a signaling complex that includes Src family kinases and TLR4/TLR6
decision_basis: CD36-tail peptide pull-down and immunoprecipitation support MISY-motif-dependent Lyn association in oxLDL-stimulated monocyte/TLR4-TLR6 systems
limitations_preserved: Promote CD36-tail/Lyn association only; preserve oxLDL and monocyte/TLR4-TLR6 context and the unresolved uniform phosphorylation status of Y463, without FYN or autonomous-CD36 inference.

primary_title: Na+/K+-ATPase alpha1 subunit is a regulator of CD36-mediated oxLDL uptake and atherosclerosis
decision_basis: OxLDL-stimulated macrophage assays support CD36 association with Na+/K+-ATPase alpha1 and dependence of Lyn activation and lipid uptake on the receptor complex
limitations_preserved: Promote ligand-dependent CD36-associated complex assembly with ATP1A1; preserve NKA as a complex component rather than isolated direct ligand, oxLDL/atherosclerosis context and erratum caveat, without SCI inference.

primary_title: SNX17 recognizes the NPxY motif in the cytoplasmic domain of LRP1 for endosomal recycling
decision_basis: LRP1-tail mapping and mutagenesis support SNX17 binding through the proximal NPxY-containing domain with recycling-versus-degradation trafficking effects
limitations_preserved: Promote direct proximal LRP1 NPxY/SNX17 recycling association; preserve flanking-sequence dependence and endosomal sorting context, without ligand occupancy, kinase or SCI inference.

primary_title: A contactin-associated protein is required for the surface expression of contactin-1
decision_basis: Contactin-1 and Caspr1 form a cis adhesion complex required for Caspr1 surface delivery in transfection, chimeric-domain and lipid-raft assays
limitations_preserved: Promote contactin-1/Caspr1 cis-complex assembly and biosynthetic trafficking; preserve neuronal/paranodal context and do not infer ligand-induced signaling or SCI function.

primary_title: Caspr1 regulates the processing and axonal localization of contactin
decision_basis: NF155-Fc binds contactin-expressing cells and coexpression assays support direct contactin-1/NF155 extracellular interaction within the paranodal adhesion complex
limitations_preserved: Promote contactin-1/NF155 extracellular adhesion-complex binding with Caspr1 modulation caveat; preserve glial-axonal context and do not represent an unconditional productive ternary complex.

primary_title: Association of protein 4.1B with the cytoplasmic domain of Caspr1
decision_basis: Caspr1 cytoplasmic-domain pull-downs and 4.1B interaction assays, supported by mutant paranodal mouse studies, establish association and membrane-barrier function
limitations_preserved: Promote Caspr1/4.1B adaptor association and paranodal barrier function; preserve Caspr2 family-binding caveat and no downstream signaling or SCI inference.

primary_title: A dishevelled-1/Smad1 interaction couples WNT and bone morphogenetic protein signaling pathways in uncommitted bone marrow stromal cells
decision_basis: Primary co-IP and mutant/reporter assays support DVL1-SMAD1 WNT-BMP crosstalk; exact association materialized.
limitations_preserved: Preserve Smad1 linker, BMP2/Wnt3a and osteoblast-progenitor context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Signaling crosstalk between TGFbeta and Dishevelled/Par1b
decision_basis: Primary HEK293T/Xenopus assays support Wnt5a-fostered PAR1B-DVL3-SMAD4 grouped-complex assembly and SMAD4 protection.
limitations_preserved: Preserve grouped DVL3-SMAD4 complex, Wnt5a and noncatalytic PAR1B context; no separate binary-edge or terminal-TF claim.

primary_title: Axin facilitates Smad3 activation in the transforming growth factor beta signaling pathway
decision_basis: Primary direct pulldown/co-IP and receptor-presentation assays support AXIN1-SMAD3 binding.
limitations_preserved: Preserve inactive/cytoplasmic SMAD3 and AXIN1 adaptor context; no autonomous kinase, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Axin is a scaffold protein in TGF-beta signaling that promotes degradation of Smad7 by Arkadia
decision_basis: Primary ternary-complex and turnover assays support AXIN1-SMAD7 association within the Arkadia scaffold.
limitations_preserved: Preserve AXIN1-SMAD7-Arkadia ternary context; AXIN1 is not the E3 ligase and no terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Axin is a scaffold protein in TGF-beta signaling that promotes degradation of Smad7 by Arkadia
decision_basis: Primary endogenous co-IP, yeast-two-hybrid and GST pulldown support AXIN1-RNF111/Arkadia association.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RNF111/Arkadia E3 and AXIN1-SMAD7 scaffold context; no AXIN1 catalytic claim.

primary_title: Axin and GSK3-beta control Smad3 protein stability and modulate TGF-beta signaling
decision_basis: Primary kinase/phosphosite, mutant, ubiquitination and stability assays support GSK3B-SMAD3 Thr66 phosphorylation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve nonactivated SMAD3 pT66 and basal-degradation context; do not transfer to SMAD2 or infer terminal transcription.

primary_title: Arkadia amplifies TGF-beta superfamily signalling through degradation of Smad7
decision_basis: Primary interaction, E3-mutant, ubiquitination, proteasome and turnover assays support RNF111/Arkadia-mediated SMAD7 degradation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RNF111 RING-E3 activity and SMAD7 substrate/degradation semantics; no receptor or terminal-TF inference.
